turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Yes. First, one example with every step.
"My uncle ___ very tall." Step 1: who? "My uncle" is one man, like "he". Step 2: "he" goes with "is". So: "My uncle is very tall."
Rule: I takes am, he/she/it takes is, and you/we/they take are.
Right: The flowers are pretty. Wrong: The flowers pretty.

Your turn. Fill in one word:
Write am, is or are: I ___ a student. (answer with only the missing word)
